name: reveal-unicode-poisoning-local
description: Local Layer A Unicode detector for invisible format characters, spaces, tags, bidi controls and selected confusables

commands.title: Scan File for Layer A Unicode

unicodePoisonDetector.scanOnSave.description: Automatically scan the active visible file when it is saved

unicodePoisonDetector.scanOnOpen.description: Automatically scan a visible file when it becomes active

unicodePoisonDetector.severity.description: Diagnostic severity used for Unicode tag characters

unicodePoisonDetector.aggressive.description: Also flag the mapped Cyrillic and fullwidth Latin confusables from the original Layer A detector

unicodePoisonDetector.stripEmojiGlue.description: Also flag contextually valid emoji joiners/selectors and script glue. Keep disabled for ordinary documents.
